description: List upcoming scheduled collection days from the service calendar, each with the identifiers needed to skip it (rid, clid), the service date, and whether it is currently scheduled or already skipped. view "brief" answers one line per day instead: "Compost pickup — <ISO date> — scheduled|skipped". Read-only — use crowntown_skip_service to actually skip/unskip.

view.description: "full" (default) returns each day with its skip ids; "brief" returns one line per day: Compost pickup — <ISO date or "no date"> — <scheduled|skipped>.

name: crowntown_list_upcoming_services
title: List upcoming (skippable) services
